semiconductor_relevance: High — Raintree Scientific Instruments specializes in process control equipment critical for semiconductor IC manufacturing.
summary: Raintree Scientific Instruments (Shanghai) Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells process control equipment for the semiconductor IC industry. Their product offerings include thin film and optical critical dimension metrology tools, macro defect inspection equipment, and optical defect detection systems, which are essential for enhancing process control and inspection capabilities in IC manufacturing.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai, focusing on development and manufacturing of semiconductor equipment.
